Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You soften into a ribbon of clay and feel the narrow opening slide around you.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, through one narrow opening to a visible free square within 3 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Movement / Utility

Become a ribbon of living clay and slip through a continuous open route to the destination. Carried equipment travels with you; reform immediately. This movement does not provoke. You cannot pass a sealed barrier, end inside an object, or remain amorphous for protection.
